user.description: Choose where your drinks come from. Local only needs the WaterH Sync Android app and no WaterH account.

menu_options.local: Local only (WaterH Sync app, no account)

cloud.title: Sign in to WaterH
cloud.description: Use the email and password for your WaterH app account. If you signed up with Google or Facebook, set a password first with "Forgot password" in the WaterH app. Your password is only used to get a login token and is not stored.

local.title: Local only
local.description:
Drinks will come straight from your bottle through the WaterH Sync Android app and be stored in Home Assistant. Nothing is sent to WaterH, and no WaterH account is needed.

Don't open the official WaterH app while using local mode: it takes the drinks off the bottle, and Home Assistant would never see them.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names, e.g. "Bottle" gives sensor.waterh_bottle_water_today.

local_finish.title: Connect the WaterH Sync app
local_finish.description:
In WaterH Sync, choose **Local only** and paste this URL. Keep it private; anyone who has it can add drinks.

{webhook_url}

You can find it again later under Configure.

If your phone should sync while away from home, use your external or Nabu Casa remote URL. Otherwise drinks wait on the bottle until you're home.
